name: RDS03-94
summary: RDS03-94, or RDS3-094, is an atypical dopamine reuptake inhibitor that was derived from the wakefulness-promoting agent modafinil.

pharmacology.text: RDS03-94, or RDS3-094, is an atypical dopamine reuptake inhibitor that was derived from the wakefulness-promoting agent modafinil. It has substantially higher affinity and potency in terms of dopamine transporter (DAT) inhibition than modafinil (Ki = 39.4 nM vs. 8,160 nM) whilst retaining the atypical DAT blocker profile of modafinil.

uses.text: RDS03-94 is under development for the treatment of psychostimulant use disorder.

fact.en: RDS03-94 came from reworking modafinil's structure. Modafinil itself was discovered in France in the 1970s from research on compounds related to adrafinil.
fact.zh: RDS03-94 是改造莫待芬寧結構而來的。莫待芬寧本身是 1970 年代在法國研究阿屈非尼相關化合物時發現的。
fact.zhHans: RDS03-94 是改造莫待芬宁结构而来的。莫待芬宁本身是 1970 年代在法国研究阿屈非尼相关化合物时发现的。
